nodes.line: Back again, what's that you've got?/No. Don't take it out. I can feel it.
nodes.note: rare unease; the grumble drops away.

nodes.line: Back again? Good. Knee says rain./Buying, or just leaning on my counter?
Rumors. Hm./Wolf pack's got a new leader out in/the Outer Barrow. Big. Dire big.
nodes.note: he lowers his voice and leans in.

nodes.line: Hunter saw it up close. Lived, barely./Says it's got a tooth that isn't/its own. Too long. Wrong color.
Not this one. Doesn't eat what it/kills. Hunter swears it's got a tooth/that isn't its own.
nodes.note: a little offended that you'd brush it off.

nodes.line: Like bone that's been in the ground/too long. I dug these hills forty/years. Some things you leave buried.
nodes.note: quiet; the one moment he isn't joking.

nodes.line: Then buy a potion first. Advice is/free. Potions aren't.
nodes.note: back to grumbling, covering the unease.

nodes.line: Course it did./Things that come out of those hills/rarely come out alone. Watch yourself.
nodes.note: a warning from someone who once heard the stone knock back.

nodes.line: Mind the barrow. And your knees./Trust me on the knees.
